plain: A slide into worse moral or physical condition.

webster.text: A growing worse or inferior; a decline in good qualities; or a state of being less valuable; as the degeneracy of a plant.

more.text: In morals, decay of virtue; a growing worse; departure from the virtues of ancestors; desertion of that which is good.

example.quote: The means relied on in this form of government for preventing their degeneracy are numerous and various.
